snippet.title: ANGEL Trailer - Convergence Gaming Showcase
snippet.description:
ANGEL, by Michael Hunter Games, is a narrative-driven rhythm/racing adventure game that immerses players in the hauntingly beautiful world of eCho, a dying digital network teetering on the brink of obsolescence. Blending innovative gameplay mechanics with a thought-provoking narrative, ANGEL invites players to explore existential themes of identity, creation, and purpose, all wrapped in a unique visual and auditory experience.

This trailer was revealed in the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase. Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884840/Angel/
